rationale.consistency: Follows api/ghinstance/config/cmdutil idioms (FlagErrorf, heredoc.Docf, prefix helpers, test helper in-package like prompter). Prose-heavy comment style and errors.Join usage differ from surrounding code.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers extensions, sizes, dir/non-regular/empty, SameFile dupes, '#' in names, ref-defs, code spans. But issue create never treats --attach alone as body input, and a partial upload failure still writes the body, contrary to 'nothing is written'.
rationale.scope: Mostly on target, but adds unrequested behaviours (video degrade-to-link, ref-image video refusal), an unused UploadStub type, an always-true KeepExistingBody knob, and changes --json repository output for pr/issue view.
rationale.readability: Clear names and structure, but references.go is 724 lines of hand-rolled byte scanning; attachableMarkdown/attachedMarkdown are confusingly similar; many comments are verbose prose.
rationale.robustness: Bodies/responses closed, nil-safe Flag methods, bounds-checked scanners, overlapping edits guarded, errors joined not dropped. Stale ContentLength from validation-time Stat and 404→no-write mapping are minor risks.
rationale.maintainability: Four near-identical *Uploader constructors across packages, hasDeferredEdits duplicates the flag computation in NewCmdEdit, image markdown rendering duplicated between asset and attachmentArg; custom markdown scanner is a long-term burden.
